title: Fixed Open-Ring Armillary Display
description: One original complete fixed open-ring armillary-style display: a broad circular pedestal and four curved splayed standards support an open horizontal horizon band, a larger upright meridian hoop, two tilted interior annular bands carried by paired radial trunnions, and a small central sphere on a fixed polar spindle. The large empty spaces between bands are the main body, not a solid globe recolored or the old equatorial telescope mount. All bands have finite closed thickness and the whole geometry is newly authored. Junctions are fixed intentional assembly overlaps, not free-running bearings. A fictional static astronomical display only: no accurate celestial coordinate system, calibrated scale, astronomical measurement, navigation, historical reconstruction, motion range, manufacture or structural safety claim.
